requirementClassification.explicitRequirement: Install AgentRouter tools natively on local Windows
requirementClassification.guiAndSharedHomeAfterStartupCheck: Additional runtime and preservation assurance beyond the explicit native installation requirement; this assurance remains unverified.
requirementClassification.preservationScope: Existing DataElement installed registration/image are observed and left running; current original shared-home contents and post-start retention are not claimed.

remainingPreconditions: All original shared-home DataElement and official application processes must be absent without this observer stopping user processes.
The prepared retention guard requires a corrected native compile and reviewed binding before use.
A source-proved owned normal-quit route with bounded completion must be established for the actual observed product state.
Fresh current original shared-home state must be bound before startup; original credential/record bytes and logical JSON values must be retained after normal exit.
